investigation_findings.root_cause_1: Disjoint identifier schemas: Subset B VMs were synthesized as vm_00000..vm_07643 from instance_events, whereas Subset A timeseries retained Borg composite task IDs (collection_id_instance_index).
investigation_findings.root_cause_2: Horizontal hash-sharding in Google Cluster 2019: Telemetry is distributed across 106,726 files. Single extracted shard 170 captures sparse tasks with zero ID overlap between instance_events sample and instance_usage sample.
investigation_findings.scientific_integrity_enforcement: Fallback predictions are strictly labeled Category C and never represented as empirical LSTM forecasts.
